The Chronicles of Aethelgard
By Arthur Pendelton

Chapter 1: The Awakening

The ancient tower stood silent against the twilight sky. For three centuries, no light had danced behind its stained glass windows, until tonight.

Kaelen stirred, feeling the cold flagstone beneath his fingertips. His memory was fractured like a shattered mirror, with only whispers of fire and incantations lingering in his mind.

"You're awake," a voice spoke from the shadows. A slender figure draped in silver-threaded silk stepped into the moonlight. "We feared the binding spell was too strong."

Chapter 2: Into the Whispering Woods

Morning broke with a pale, silver mist that clung to the boughs of the ironwood trees. The path ahead twisted into darkness, where even the wind dared not speak above a murmur.

"Stay close," Lyra cautioned, checking the runes engraved along the edge of her staff. "The woods remember what was buried here."

Kaelen nodded, adjusting the leather sheath at his belt. Every step forward felt like stepping through the veil of time itself.

Chapter 3: The Gate of Embers

At the edge of the forgotten crater lay the Arch of Solitude. Intricate glyphs pulsed with a slow, rhythmic amber glow.

"This is as far as the map goes," Kaelen whispered, gazing up at the monumental stones.

"Then we make our own map," Lyra smiled quietly, placing her hand upon the keystone. The earth began to tremble.
